summary: OpenAI has made significant strides in mathematics and theoretical computer science, addressing longstanding challenges and yielding advancements in geometry, cryptography, and complexity theory, which are crucial for the field. Additionally, OpenAI emphasizes responsible AI practices, particularly in light of the EU AI Act's progression, focusing on safety, security, transparency, and provenance to enhance AI governance. In robotics, Google DeepMind's Gemini Robotics ER 2 enhances collaboration among robots through advanced video understanding and task orchestration, showcasing the potential for improved AI-robot interactions. Meanwhile, Fund Momentum MCP offers real-time data on venture capital funds tailored for AI, impacting investment decisions for startups in a rapidly evolving landscape.

Include more details about the implications of Gemini Robotics ER 2 for robotics and AI collaboration.
Clarify the role of Fund Momentum MCP in the AI investment landscape and its potential impact on startups.

items.original: Orchard: An open framework for scalable agentic AI. Orchard is an open-source framework for the research community to train and evaluate AI agents across task types. It reduces complexity while supporting strong performance from smaller models by enabling researchers to reuse the same infrastructure. The post Orchard: An open framework for scalable agentic AI appeared first on Microsoft Research .
